about_the_game:
The Digital Goodies Pack is an additional set of materials created to complement your Campus Life experience. Inside, you’ll find a digital artbook, the complete original soundtrack, and a collection of bonus digital items.

The artbook offers a look behind the scenes, showcasing sketches, concepts, and early designs that shape the world of Campus Life. The soundtrack features a mix of relaxed and energetic tracks that reflect different moments of student life, from study sessions to social events. This pack also includes a selection of wallpapers, letting you carry a piece of Campus Life outside the game.

It’s designed for players who enjoy exploring not only the finished product, but also the creative journey that led to it. Whether you’re a fan of game development, a collector of digital extras, or someone who wants to stay immersed in the atmosphere beyond play sessions, the Digital Goodies Pack adds an extra layer of depth to your experience.

You can find the DLC content in the game files, in the folder named "supporter pack".

  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1st gen / Intel Core i5 7th gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 4GB / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
